evidence.why: AssertionError's computed [inspect.custom] method is a real callee reached only through value[customInspectSymbol](...) in formatValue — a computed property key read into a local (customInspectSymbol) and invoked, matching the dynamic-property-keyed-callback pattern, but no static call site names the method, so Ariadne's resolver (and this rule's classifier) missed it.
